assembly: Resolve historical incomplete-status wording using the accepted whole collar proof; include all accepted own proof annexes and their contact reconstruction; rename the identified tilde pairing to MA.

metadata_and_status_replacements.before: This is constructed for the entire cone before any target is chosen. It is a positive symmetric Radon measure of raw mass $V$. It gives $P$ zero mass by Section 6. Its local finite and limiting properties proved next give more information than a bare transported-measure definition, but we retain the tilde until the remaining bridge in Section 10 is established.
metadata_and_status_replacements.after: This pairing is constructed for the entire cone before any target is chosen. It is a positive symmetric Radon measure of raw mass $V$, giving $P$ zero mass by Section 6. Section 10 constructs the intrinsic local products of the actual original metric and proves that their nonpluripolar reference-floor extension equals this pairing. Thus it is the genuine original-carrier operator; the equality with the ample measure is a conclusion of that local construction.

metadata_and_status_replacements.before: This proves a genuine decreasing local limit for a specified actual-section category, with all-point endpoints and germ independence inside that category. It does not yet prove the comparison with a construction made from only locally defined contact nets and a collar; that comparison is the remaining issue.
metadata_and_status_replacements.after: This proves a genuine decreasing local limit for the full type-preserving original-section category, with all-point endpoints and germ independence. Section 10 proves its equality with independently supplied admissible local contact nets using one common actual ample collar.

The independently constructed local product in Section 10 agrees with these restrictions and floors, completing the intrinsic operator identification before any target is chosen.
